title: Delhi Police issues notice to Mamata Banerjee as witness in 2013 protest case

ai.summary: Delhi Police served a notice to Mamata Banerjee to record a statement in a 2013 case involving police confrontation, according to PTI.

facts.claim: Delhi Police served a notice to Mamata Banerjee
facts.quote: Delhi Police on Monday served a notice to former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee, asking her to record her statement in connection with a 2013 case involving a confrontation with police, news agency PTI reported, citing sources.
